messages:
Noah Reed (CSM): Heads-up — MetroGrid's activity dropped from ~90k tokens/day to ~200 tokens since 2024-06-25. Renewal in 6w. Procurement cc'd.
Zoe Martinez (AE): Did procurement ask for alternatives or just infra notes?
Noah Reed (CSM): Procurement asked for SOC2 addendum and said they're "exploring edge-local runtimes". Not explicit vendor names.
Ibrahim Khan (Solutions): Support, check edge logs for any 4xx spikes or key rotations. Also maybe they rotated env var with API key.
Tess Morgan (Support): Quick check: last good request 06/25 11:07 UTC. Between 11:08–11:35 we saw 401s then silence. Most 401s from two IPs tagged as their gateway.
Noah Reed (CSM): I just DM'd their infra lead asking if they intentionally paused traffic. Offered a 20-min ops triage.
redwood-bot: Reminder — open renewal-watch RW-2024-714 and link to account metrogrid.
Zoe Martinez (AE): RW-2024-714 created. Offer: 2-week Dedicated trial + migration concierge? Worth it to preserve renewal?
Ibrahim Khan (Solutions): On the call we should show a quick test: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"input":"ping"}'` and a fallback regional endpoint. I'll draft a 1-pager.
Tess Morgan (Support): Found one trace where mesh rewrote Host -> internal-llm.local and stripped Authorization header -> causing 401. Will paste trace in the invite.
Noah Reed (CSM): Good find. Ask them to whitelist header passthrough or use header-preserving egress. Scheduling ops sync tomorrow 08:00 PT. If they confirm competitor PoC escalate to Sales.
Zoe Martinez (AE): I'll prep concession thresholds and ask procurement for timeline. Update after sync. :+1:
